links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT-4o interpretations across repeated prompts
links.effect: Interobserver agreement was high (kappa = 0.920), while reliability with a second prompt was moderate (kappa = 0.750).
links.quote: Interobserver agreement was high (kappa = 0.920), and reliability (second prompt) was moderate (kappa = 0.750).

links.outcome: Standalone diagnostic accuracy of ChatGPT-4o on X-rays versus expert radiologist findings
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o correctly identified 345 of 500 (69%) pathologies; 72.02% for AXRs, 66.15% for CXRs. Standalone performance only; no human-AI team evaluated.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o correctly identified 345 of 500 (69%) pathologies (95% CI: 64.81-72.9).

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and patient safety ratings of a multimodal LLM (ChatGPT-4o) on a dataset of chest and abdominal X-rays compared to expert interpretation.
